title: Intake Form → Priced Proposal PDF → Sent for Signature

sections.label: 1 · INTAKE
sections.note: The scoping form comes in with the job details. Values are validated up front, so a missing square footage stops the run here rather than producing a proposal with a blank in it.

sections.label: 2 · PRICE
sections.note: Line items are priced from the live rate table, not hardcoded. Margin rules and minimums are applied in one place, so pricing changes never mean editing a template.

sections.label: 3 · BUILD
sections.note: The scope narrative is written for this specific job, merged into the branded template, and exported to PDF. What differs between proposals is the writing — the layout stays identical.

sections.label: 4 · SEND
sections.note: The proposal goes out for signature and the deal moves to Proposal Sent with the document attached, so the pipeline reflects reality without anyone updating it by hand.

input_sample.notes: Clinic can only be down on weekends.

output_sample.scope_narrative: Both rooftop units are past the point where repair makes financial sense on a clinic that cannot afford unplanned downtime. We'll stage the replacement across two consecutive weekends so the practice never loses a weekday, rebalance the duct runs afterward since the existing distribution was sized for the old equipment, and bring all four zones onto a single controller.
